name: climb-trainer
description: Climbing training app — plan generator, guided session player, training diary

scripts.build: npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.check:web: npm --prefix web run format:check && npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix web run test && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.check:server: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy && CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173 uv run pytest -q
scripts.check: npm run check:web && npm run check:server
